data.body: Investigation: behavior already fixed in commit 2bdbb2d2e3 ('fix(bridge-inbound): watermark-based cursor + dead-letter sidecar'). bridge-inbound.py now (a) returns early without writing checkpoint on all-fail runs, (b) raises 'checkpoint NOT updated' on auth failure, (c) advances cursor to high-watermark of acknowledged issues, not now(). No additional code change required.
